SELECT t.code,t.name FROM community_tag t WHERE t.enabled = 1 AND (LEFT(t.code,7)<>'custom_' OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_article_tag atg JOIN cms_news n ON n.id = atg.news_id LEFT JOIN community_article a ON a.news_id = n.id WHERE atg.tag_id = t.id AND n.is_deleted = 0 AND n.publish_status = 1 AND n.publish_at<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (n.community_managed = 0 OR a.state = 'PUBLISHED') AND (NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_article_access ac WHERE ac.news_id = n.id AND ac.visibility<>'PUBLIC') OR ( SELECT va.author_user_id FROM community_article va WHERE va.news_id = n.id) = #{viewer} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_article_access ac JOIN community_article_reader ar ON ar.news_id = ac.news_id WHERE ac.news_id = n.id AND ac.visibility = 'FRIENDS' AND ar.user_id = #{viewer} AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_follow f WHERE f.follower_id = #{viewer} AND f.target_key = CONCAT('u',( SELECT va.author_user_id FROM community_article va WHERE va.news_id = n.id)) AND f.following = 1) AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_follow f WHERE f.follower_id = ( SELECT va.author_user_id FROM community_article va WHERE va.news_id = n.id) AND f.target_key = CONCAT('u',#{viewer}) AND f.following = 1))) AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM community_article_hidden ah WHERE ah.news_id = n.id AND ah.user_id = #{viewer}) )) ORDER BY t.sort_no,t.id
